'''R'han''' was a [[H'drachi]] Rebel on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] and son of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ph'dan]]. He was presumed dead after an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], but was in truth captured and put to work in [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Grigor (governor)|Grigor's]] [[dragite crystal]] mine. A group of local rebels led by [[Mora]] freed R'han and the other prisoners during an attack on the mine.
